name: Gal Jacobson
headline: Senior Software Engineer
heroTagline: Designing and building resilient, high-throughput systems — clean architecture, reliable infrastructure, interfaces people enjoy using.
about: Senior Software Engineer building scalable, high-performance software end to end — from architecture and infrastructure to the last pixel of the interface, across Node.js, React, Docker, PostgreSQL, Apollo, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP).

Proven track record of shipping large-scale features and optimizing distributed systems — leading work from planning to production with global, cross-functional teams while keeping quality, performance, and user value in focus.

A problem-solver drawn to the hard seams between systems — integrations, edge cases, and performance ceilings — with the attention to detail that turns a working feature into one that feels inevitable.

experience.title: Full-Stack Engineer
experience.summary: Full-stack engineer in the Houzz Pro web platform documents team — responsible for core features of Houzz Pro.
bullets: Led development of multiple robust, scalable technical features, ensuring high-quality performance and reliability with substantial improvements in functionality and user adoption.
Upgraded existing systems to improve performance, maintainability, and scalability, aligning with evolving business and technical needs.
Managed large-scale projects and collaborated with cross-functional teams to derive technical design and performance requirements.
